args.body: Finish LIVECA-INVOICE-SUBTOTAL-PILOT under the valid lease. If director-contact-audience.json commits, use it to locate the exact audience and fields in the existing contact capture. If the wording and form support a supplier routing inquiry, finish the existing unsent offer with the fictional CAD 10 discrepancy, a provisional price and full effort estimate. If the form is client-specific or its actual route cannot be established from the allowed sources, save the decisive evidence and the route evidence that would reopen the prospect. Read back the committed result and close with a lesson. Reuse any completed verdict or exact-draft decision. External contact requires authorization.

description: LiveCA’s homepage confirms accounts-payable work, and its contact page returned HTTP 200. The next step is to establish whether the form can receive a supplier inquiry. The existing agent can then finish either a bounded, unsent pilot offer or a prospect-specific decision with the evidence that would reopen it. In parallel, test a published Canadian bookkeeping partner route for the same service. Commercial feedback has no new classified signal and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 verified available and CAD 0 verified revenue.
